ShippingPolicy.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
ShippingPolicy.temperatureDesc: Every Dips Chocolate order ships discreetly in temperature-optimized packaging to ensure your chocolates arrive in perfect condition.
ShippingPolicy.fulfillmentDesc: We strive to fulfill orders the same day on most weekdays and Saturdays (excluding holidays). Orders placed Saturday evening or Sunday will ship on Monday.
ShippingPolicy.shippingOptionsDesc1: We offer standard shipping starting at $[calculated at checkout] on all orders, as well as expedited 2–5 day delivery through FedEx 2-Day for an additional cost.
ShippingPolicy.shippingOptionsDesc2: All orders also qualify for DHL shipping, starting at $[calculated at checkout].
ShippingPolicy.internationalDesc: Our chocolates are proudly crafted and shipped from the U.S. We accept international orders; however, customers are responsible for ensuring compliance with local regulations. We cannot refund shipments seized by customs.
ShippingPolicy.damagedDesc: If your chocolates arrive damaged, misshapen, or melted, please contact us immediately. Upon reasonable proof, we'll provide a full refund or replacement.
ShippingPolicy.cancellationsDesc: Cancellations must be submitted via email before your order leaves our fulfillment center.
ShippingPolicy.lostPackagesDesc1: If your package is marked as delivered but cannot be located, check your mailbox and contact DHL with your tracking number.
ShippingPolicy.lostPackagesDesc2: Please note: Dips Chocolate is not responsible for lost or stolen packages once handed to the carrier.
ShippingPolicy.delaysDesc: During peak seasons, delivery may take longer than expected. If your order arrives significantly late without prior notice or cancellation options, you may qualify for a partial refund.

ReturnPolicy.title: Return & Refund Policy
ReturnPolicy.initiatingDesc: Returns must be requested within 14 days of delivery. Please contact our Customer Support team before sending any items back—returns without prior approval cannot be accepted.
ReturnPolicy.damagedDesc: If your chocolates arrive damaged, broken, misshapen, or melted, reach out to us immediately. Upon reasonable proof, we'll gladly provide a replacement to ensure your experience remains indulgent.
ReturnPolicy.chocolatePiecesDesc: If you're not delighted with your Dips, at least two of the three round chocolates must remain fully intact and unopened. Once approved, any remaining items must be returned in their original condition to qualify for a full refund. Please note: USPS return shipping fees may apply.
ReturnPolicy.shippingLabelsDesc: If your return is approved, we'll provide a prepaid shipping label. In some cases, USPS return fees may apply.
ReturnPolicy.helpingImproveDesc: We may request a photo of your return to help us refine our craft and enhance your future experience.
ReturnPolicy.refundsDesc: Refunds are credited to your original payment method. Please allow up to 7 business days for processing after approval.
ReturnPolicy.delaysDesc: During peak seasons, delivery may take longer than expected. If your order arrives significantly late without prior notice or cancellation options, you may qualify for a partial refund.
